# Permissions and roles

**13 permissions across 5 roles.** Generated by `npm run spec`.

Access is checked by middleware rather than inside a handler, so a route added
later cannot forget to check. A role is a set of permissions and nothing else —
there is no second place where a role means something.

| Permission | owner | admin | adviser | assistant | readonly |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `admin:settings` | yes | yes | · | · | · |
| `admin:users` | yes | yes | · | · | · |
| `ai:run` | yes | yes | yes | yes | · |
| `audit:read` | yes | yes | · | · | · |
| `backup:take` | yes | · | · | · | · |
| `document:read` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `document:write` | yes | yes | yes | yes | · |
| `ingest:triage` | yes | yes | yes | yes | · |
| `mail:send` | yes | yes | yes | · | · |
| `quote:write` | yes | yes | yes | · | · |
| `register:delete` | yes | yes | · | · | · |
| `register:read` | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| `register:write` | yes | yes | yes | yes | · |
